scope: Saved I3 outputs and 896 healthy candidate identities; no simulation.

combined_resources.interval_definition: Log filename Unix_ns is sampled just before Popen; receipt.wall_seconds starts just after Popen. Their sum approximates the receipt time, with launch bookkeeping error. These intervals include both successful and archived failed attempts.
combined_resources.slot_definition: Reserved-plus-active is an upper bound on occupied worker slots, not a CPU utilization measurement.
combined_resources.memory_definition: Available memory is sampled by the two pools; the 3 GiB value is the launch-budget reserve, not an assertion about unsampled instants.
